description: This file defines classes related to stopwatches, including abstract, local, distributed, and multi-stopwatch implementations for performance timing within Spark applications.

classes.name: Stopwatch
classes.description: Abstract class for stopwatches, providing timing functionalities and state management.

classes.name: LocalStopwatch
classes.description: A concrete implementation of Stopwatch for local timing within a single JVM.

classes.name: DistributedStopwatch
classes.description: A concrete implementation of Stopwatch that uses Spark's LongAccumulator for distributed timing.

classes.name: MultiStopwatch
classes.description: A container class managing multiple local and distributed stopwatches.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the stopwatch, throwing an exception if already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and returns the duration of the last session in milliseconds.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the stopwatch is currently running.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Returns total elapsed time in milliseconds, excluding the current session if running.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stopwatch with its name and elapsed time.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current system time in milliseconds.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a duration to the total elapsed time.

methods.name: addLocal
methods.description: Adds a new local stopwatch with the specified name.

methods.name: addDistributed
methods.description: Adds a new distributed stopwatch with the specified name.
